name: Generic Web Form Login
description: Logs into a standard username/password web form. Auto-detects the username, password, and submit controls using accessibility-first heuristics, so it works across many sites without per-site selectors. The doc's 'consolidated Web form login' tool (see docs/Playwright agent.md 'Generalization Over Time').

url.description: login page URL; if omitted, uses the current page

success.description: CSS/text selector that should appear ONLY when logged in (e.g. text=Sign out). Used to confirm success.

user_selector.description: override for the username field selector

pass_selector.description: override for the password field selector

output.logged_in: true when the success check passed (or, if no --success given, when the password field is gone)

dependencies: None. Works on a fresh session. For MFA-protected accounts this gets you past the password step only.
known_issues: MFA / 'verify it's you' steps are NOT handled — falls back to reporting precondition.
Multi-step logins (username on page 1, password on page 2) need the field overrides or two runs.
Without --success, success is inferred from the password field disappearing, which can false-positive on SPA redraws.
